LanguageData.SCP_650ReturnArchived: SCP-650 has been transferred to the Foundation. The completed dossier and experiment records are retained for reference.
LanguageData.SCP_650ReturnArrivedBody: The Foundation shuttle has landed and will wait for SCP-650. Select a colonist and right-click the Black Statue, then choose “Load SCP-650 aboard the Foundation shuttle”. Trust is granted only after departure with the object.
LanguageData.SCP_650ReturnLoad: Load SCP-650 aboard the Foundation shuttle
